scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.
findings: Original void(int,long) logger passes long to %x; retained undefined variadic contract has no portable parity claim. Proposed full signed-long-to-unsigned-long modulo2^64 output is an explicit defined behavior choice.

Supported Rust ABI aliases are CInt=i32, CLong=i64, CULong=u64 in kernel/rust/abi.rs:5-7; existing callback declaration is fn arch_ptrace_regset_log_bridge(CInt,CLong) returning unit. Preserve this external ABI and supported x86_64 LP64 scope.

kernel/debug.c:140 kprintf keeps existing logging prefix and locking/output machinery and passes varargs to vsnprintf at157. Contract event prefixes refer to diagnostic payload; ordinary kprintf CPU prefix, buffer availability/truncation and sink behavior remain existing behavior, not a promise of unconditional output.

lib/vsprintf.c format_decode:967-991 selects lowercase SMALL/base16 then FORMAT_TYPE_ULONG for l without SIGN. Both C fallback extraction at1331 and Rust-callback extraction at1057 use va_arg(unsigned long). Rust numparse.rs:783-806 has corresponding lowercase/base16/ULONG decode and1192 uses args.arg::<CULong>(); number_ref_result:492 onward renders zero0 and shifts fullu64, without leading padding for unadorned %lx.

Use a Rust-owned NUL-terminated static format with %lx and exactly one CULong argument obtained directly from CLong conversion. No intermediate u32/unsigned-int narrowing; no signed argument to unsigned-format varargs; no allocation or borrowed temporary format lifetime required.

Proposal alone changes no code, selectors, metadata389 tuple Counter, line!/file!/column! origins, caller actions/status/errno, memory writes, locking or lifetime. Those invariants are requirements for the future candidate, not verified implementation outcomes.
selection_conditions: Root explicitly approves this precise intentional diagnostic contract before candidate selection; retain original C and previous undefined/low-bit proposal evidence.

Candidate must preserve void(CInt,CLong) ABI, event1/event2 payload prefixes and exactly one trailing newline, return silently for every other event, and call only the existing diagnostic provider. Review exact signed-to-CULong conversion and Rust static format storage.

Bind selected formatter/build provider to reviewed %lx support; actual target compiler/ABI witness and default unique provider/link evidence remain open. A new bespoke formatter requires its own focused implementation review.

Keep inactive C fallback and supported source selection shape; compare full original389 tuple Counter byte-bound oracle unchanged and preserve macro source identities. No frozen undefined-output oracle normalization or fabricated parity.
No ptrace action/status/errno/locking/lifetime change, no new C runtime, no service/account hold clearance. Applicable compiler/link/native proof remains required before C retirement.
